<translate>
The '''Power Pole''' (Nyoibo) has the longest reach of the signature weapons: 3 blocks. Its own '''staff''' combo strings two wide sweeps into a 360° spin, and the pole visibly extends with each swing. It wins the spacing game, keeping enemies at bay. You get it as a wish from [[Special:MyLanguage/Shenron|Shenron]].
</translate>

<translate>
== Getting it ==

Gather the seven Earth Dragon Balls, summon Shenron and choose the '''Power Pole''' wish (see [[Special:MyLanguage/Dragons and Wishes|Dragons and Wishes]]).
</translate>

<translate>
== Fighting with it ==

* '''Moveset:''' its own staff combo, two wide sweeps and a spinning finisher, with a reach of 3 blocks.
* '''Critical hits:''' 15% chance, 10% critical damage.
* It is unbreakable.
* While you carry it in your inventory, it is shown on your character's back.

See [[Special:MyLanguage/Special Weapons|Special Weapons]] for how movesets, combos, blocking and parrying work.
</translate>
